snippet.title: Fallen Tear: The Ascension - Official Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is a combat and exploration driven 2D animated metroidvania. Find Fated Bonds to help you on your journey as you fight and free beasts and gods alike. Discover hidden paths, secrets, and challenges as the world dynamically transforms in response to player actions. Fallen Tear: The Ascension will be available on PC (Steam) in Q1 2026.
